data.summary:
An enterprising Agile professional and Agile leader with unparalleled experience in achieving organizational goals and succeeding in an environment of growth & excellence by leveraging on skills, knowledge and effective leadership, targeting strategic leadership assignments as a Senior Business Analyst 
16+ years of experience in Banking and Financial Services with strong expertise in Payments, Cards,
SWIFT, ISO 20022, ISO 8583, NEFT, RTGS, Reconciliation, and payment message processing.
Extensive experience
in product ownership, business analysis, stakeholder management, requirement gathering, governance, implementation, and change management across payment systems.
Strong understanding of ISO 20022 payment messaging standards and migration from legacy MT/IFTAS/SFMS messaging formats to MX/ISO 20022 standards across payment, trade finance, and cash management systems
Hands-on experience in NEFT, RTGS, SWIFT MT103, MT202, MT199, MT191, MT192, and ISO 20022 messages such as pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.002, camt.056, camt.029, and pain.001.
Strong hands-on expertise in card issuing, authorization, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, disputes, and scheme compliance (Visa & Mastercard). Proven ability to manage end-to-end delivery, covering requirements gathering, backlog management, stakeholder coordination, governance, and execution in Agile environments.
Strong exposure to application interface design, API integration, requirement documentation, interface mapping, deployment, implementation, and production support.
Proven ability to work with cross-functional teams, member banks, business stakeholders, product teams, development teams, and vendors to ensure successful implementation of payment system changes.
Experienced in preparing BRD, FRD, User Stories, Functional Specifications, Process Flows, Gap
Analysis, Impact Analysis, and Change Requests.
Strong people management and leadership skills with experience mentoring teams, managing multiple activities in parallel, and delivering projects in fast-paced, 24x7 environments.
Strong understanding of the end-to-end flow of RTGS and NEFT transactions including: Customer Initiation, Branch Validation, Core Banking System Processing, SFMS/RTGS message generation, RBI Settlement, Beneficiary Bank Acknowledgement, Final Credit Confirmation.
Familiar with payment responses such as: Positive Acknowledgement, Rejection Response, Return/Reject Scenarios, pac.002 status messages, UTR generation and tracking.
Strong knowledge of payment message statuses such as Accepted, Rejected, Pending, Returned, Settled, and Failed.
Career Timeline
2009 Jun - 2010 Sep
2010 Sep - 2012 May
2012 May - 2019 June
2019 June- 2025 March
2025 Mar – Now

Tata Consultancy Services, Operations, Manual Tester

Expleo Group Senior Business Analyst / Senior Scrum Master

Project 2: Client: – Bank of Ireland – UK - Business Analyst/Scrum Master (Jun 2019 – Mar 2025)
Led multiple payment and reconciliation projects involving SWIFT, RTGS, NEFT-equivalent payment processing, and ISO 20022 message analysis.
Conducted workshops with stakeholders to gather requirements related to payment processing,
settlement, message validation, and reconciliation.
Created detailed BRD, FRD, use cases, message flow diagrams, and functional specifications. Analyzed existing payment message formats and supported migration planning toward ISO 20022
compliant structures.
Worked extensively on SWIFT MT103, MT202, MT199 and mapped them to ISO 20022 messages. Supported trade finance message understanding including LC and BG related message flows. Prepared business rules and validation rules for inward and outward payments through RTGS and
NEFT channels.
Coordinated with development, QA, and infrastructure teams for message integration, API
testing, deployment, and production support.
Used for requirement tracking, project management, reporting, and stakeholder communication. Conducted requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders to understand
reconciliation and payment processing needs.
Prepared BRD, FRD, process flows, and functional specifications for banking applications. Created and maintained User Stories, acceptance criteria, and backlog items in Jira. Worked closely with development, QA, and product teams to ensure correct implementation of
requirements. Supported payments reconciliation processes and transaction monitoring systems. Ensured clear communication between business stakeholders and development teams
Project 3: Client: – Citibank - India | Manual Tester (Mar 2018 – Jun 2019)
Supported merchant onboarding workflows by analyzing business requirements related to merchant registration, payment configuration, and transaction processing setup.
Collaborated with business and technology teams to ensure merchant payment gateway integration
and configuration were aligned with Visa and Mastercard standards.
Assisted in defining functional requirements for merchant onboarding, KYC verification, and
payment acceptance configuration. Worked with stakeholders to ensure merchant profiles, settlement configurations, and dispute handling processes were correctly captured in system requirements
Project 4: Client: Standard Chartered Bank – UK |Manual Tester (Mar 2017 – Mar 2018)
Gained a comprehensive understanding of business requirements for AML and executed manual
testing on web-based applications.
Participated in Test Plan, Test Scenarios, Test Cases and Test data preparation.
Identifying and reporting the defects using JIRA and follow up with the respective people until its closure. Raise the bugs in JIRA and Re-test resolved defect. Report testing status to QA Manager and Project Team weekly.
Project 5: Client: Mashreq Bank – Dubai | Cards Interchange Settlement, Disputes (Jan 2016 – Feb 2017)
Experience in Credit card settlement posting in Consumer banking operations. Perform the Chargeback Acquiring Process Activities. Performed proper review and investigated disputed card transactions by collecting
sufficient information to explore every opportunity to identify recover opportunities.
Project 6: Client: Citi Bank – Australia |Payments, Reconciliation, KYC & AML (May 2012 – Jan’16)
Performed KYC Check, Signature Verification, Name Screening Check for A/C Opening Process. Processing of Foreign Currency Incoming & Outgoing Funds transfer request. Customer Debit and Credit will be verified, Fund Transfer such as MT103, MT202, MT191, MT192. Perform reconciliation of existing internal list entries and keywords used for transaction screening.
Strong Knowledge of AML/CTF and Sanctions acquiring work.
3. Work Experience – Process Associate, Williams Lea (2011 Jan – 2012 May)
Client: Medicare Health – USA | HealthCare
Reviewed and resolved claims by analysing documentation, calculating benefits, and issuing
payments or denial letters.
4. Work Experience – Jr Process Associate, Dell Systems (2009 May – 2011 Jan)
Client: Athena HealthCare – USA | HealthCare
Analysed and processed medical claims, ensuring compliance with insurance policies and regulations.
Collaborated with legal teams to prepare documentation for claims disputes and settlements.
Key Achievements:
Successfully led and supported multiple banking and payments projects across Cards, SWIFT, Reconciliation, Merchant Onboarding, and Payment Systems. • Contributed to payment message transformation initiatives and supported ISO 20022 readiness activities. • Managed multiple stakeholders and parallel workstreams in fast-paced delivery environments. • Delivered projects on time through effective planning, stakeholder communication, issue resolution, and team coordination. • Mentored junior team members and supported business and technical teams in understanding payment message standards and process flows. Awards & Recognition
Received Spot Award for successfully delivering critical payments and reconciliation projects within tight timelines and with zero production impact. • Recognized by stakeholders and senior management for excellent ownership, responsiveness, and proactive communication during high-priority payment transformation initiatives. • Appreciated for leading multiple parallel workstreams and ensuring successful delivery of complex banking projects involving SWIFT, Cards, Reconciliation, and ISO 20022 readiness. • Received client appreciation for quick issue resolution, strong stakeholder management, and consistent on-time delivery. • Awarded for mentoring team members and supporting cross-functional teams during implementation, UAT, and production rollout activities. • Recognized for driving process improvements, reducing manual effort, and improving reporting visibility through structured tracking and governance. • Appreciated for handling critical production issues and ensuring business continuity in 24x7 banking and payment environments.
